SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRAVEL_POST bp INNER JOIN MEMBER m ON bp.SEQMEMBER = m.SEQMEMBER WHERE bp.STATUS = 'NORMAL'
AND ( bp.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{searchWord} || '%' OR REGEXP_REPLACE(bp.CONTENT, '<[^>]+>', '') LIKE '%' || #{searchWord} || '%' )
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQTRAVELPOST.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TRAVEL_POST ( SEQTRAVELPOST, SEQMEMBER, TITLE, CONTENT, VIEWCOUNT, STATUS, CREATEDATE, THUMBNAILURL ) VALUES ( #{seqTravelPost}, #{seqMember}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, 'NORMAL', SYSDATE, #{thumbnailUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO TRAVEL_POST_FILE ( SEQTRAVELPOSTFILE, SEQTRAVELPOST, ORIGINALNAME, SAVEDNAME, FILEPATH, FILESIZE, FILETYPE, CREATEDATE ) VALUES ( SEQTRAVELPOSTFILE.NEXTVAL, #{seqTravelPost}, #{originalName}, #{savedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT tp.SEQTRAVELPOST AS seqTravelPost, tp.SEQMEMBER AS seqMember, tp.TITLE AS title, tp.CONTENT AS content, tp.VIEWCOUNT AS viewCount, tp.STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(tp.CREATEDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createDate, TO_CHAR(tp.UPDATEDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updateDate, m.NAME AS writerName FROM TRAVEL_POST tp INNER JOIN MEMBER m ON tp.SEQMEMBER = m.SEQMEMBER WHERE tp.SEQTRAVELPOST = #{seqTravelPost} AND tp.STATUS = 'NORMAL'

SELECT SEQTRAVELPOSTFILE AS seqTravelPostFile, SEQTRAVELPOST AS seqTravelPost, ORIGINALNAME AS originalName, SAVEDNAME AS savedName, FILESIZE AS fileSize, FILETYPE AS fileType, TO_CHAR(CREATEDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createDate FROM TRAVEL_POST_FILE WHERE SEQTRAVELPOST = #{seqTravelPost} ORDER BY SEQTRAVELPOSTFILE ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TRAVEL_POST SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, UPDATEDATE = SYSDATE, THUMBNAILURL = #{thumbnailUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE SEQTRAVELPOST = #{seqTravelPost}
UPDATE TRAVEL_POST SET STATUS = 'DELETED', UPDATEDATE = SYSDATE WHERE SEQTRAVELPOST = #{seqTravelPost}
mapper.select: SELECT l.SEQLOCATION AS seqLocation, l.PLACENAME AS placeName, l.ADDRESS AS address, l.LATITUDE AS latitude, l.LONGITUDE AS longitude FROM ROUTINE r INNER JOIN LOCATION l ON r.SEQLOCATION = l.SEQLOCATION WHERE r.SEQTRAVELPOST = #{seqTravelPost} ORDER BY r.SEQ ASC

SELECT l.SEQLOCATION AS seqLocation, l.PLACENAME AS placeName, l.ADDRESS AS address, l.LATITUDE AS latitude, l.LONGITUDE AS longitude, l.MAPPROVIDERID AS mapProviderId FROM ROUTINE r INNER JOIN LOCATION l ON r.SEQLOCATION = l.SEQLOCATION WHERE r.SEQTRAVELPOST = #{seqTravelPost} ORDER BY r.SEQ ASC
